Calendar

Stacked like a deck of playing cards, each calendar cycles through granular `--cal-*` themes with gradient backgrounds.

Inline Calendar

Add `data-zaiku-calendar` to a container. Use `data-type` for single, range, or multiple selection.

Range Selection

Click two dates to select a range.

Grouped Calendar (Dual Panel)

Use `data-panels=

2` to show two months side-by-side with shared navigation. The g is configurable via `data-panel-g`.
Grouped Range

Two panels with range selection — perfect for booking widgets. With `data-split-range`, ranges that cross disabled dates are split into segments. Use `data-min-stay` to require a minimum number of nights per segment (default 1).

Total nights
—
Popover Calendar

Link a calendar to an input via `data-target`. Click the input to open, select a date to fill it.

Popover Grouped Range

A dual-panel range picker in popover mode — ideal for check-in / check-out booking forms.

Disabled Dates

Use `data-min-date`, `data-max-date`, `data-disabled-dates`, or `data-disabled-days` to restrict selection.

Multiple Selection

Click multiple dates to toggle them.

Blocked Dates

Mark specific dates as blocked with extra info via `data-blocked-dates`. Click a blocked date to retrieve its data — useful for showing holidays, bookings, or unavailable slots.

Click a blocked date to see details
Date Details

Enable `data-enable-date-details` to open a popover when clicking a date. Use `onDetailOpen(popoverEl, date, instance)` to inject your own content into the popover.

Select a date to add details
Programmatic API

Access the calendar instance via `container.zaiku.calendarInstance`. Use `getValue()`, `prevMonth()`, `nextMonth()`, `isWeekday()`, and runtime options like `preventPastDays` and `preventPastMonths`.
